title: Password Credential Hashing Capability Selection
objective: Define the safe provider-neutral password credential and hashing boundary for River Identity, preserve Argon2id as the preferred password hashing algorithm, and require an explicit Cloudflare Workers capability proof before selecting a production implementation.

inheritedArchitecture.principalDatabase: Dedicated shared River Identity D1 database
inheritedArchitecture.sessionRequirement: Authenticated sessions must carry or resolve PrincipalId.
inheritedArchitecture.productIdentityRule: PrincipalId remains distinct from SeshCreatorId, CRM Person identity, legal/account identity, and session identity.

existingRiverOsAuth.restriction: MUST NOT be interpreted as PrincipalId or product-user authentication.

cloudflareWorkers.consequence: Do not implement Argon2id by importing node:crypto argon2 or argon2Sync.

runtimeCapabilityFindings.compatibilityRule: Do not assume newer automatic Node.js compatibility behavior without an explicit compatibility-date or flag decision.
runtimeCapabilityFindings.nativeArgon2Conclusion: Native Cloudflare Workers node:crypto cannot satisfy the preferred Argon2id implementation.

rationale: SESH-012 already selected a memory-hard password hashing requirement and Argon2id preference.
The absence of native Workers Argon2 support does not by itself justify downgrading the architecture.
Worker-compatible JavaScript and precompiled WebAssembly implementations exist as capability candidates.
A production library must be proven inside the actual Worker-compatible build/runtime boundary before adoption.
forbidden: Client-side password hash accepted as the credential secret
Silent fallback to a weaker algorithm

pbkdf2.reason: Availability alone does not satisfy the locked preference for a memory-hard password KDF.

scrypt.role: Potential explicit fallback only if Argon2id cannot be safely supported.
scrypt.rule: Any fallback requires a separate architectural decision and must not happen implicitly.

implementationCandidates.capability: Argon2id implementation available through the library's Argon2 KDF surface.
advantages: No reliance on unsupported node:crypto Argon2.
Can remain behind a provider-neutral PasswordHasher contract.
requiredProof: Package installs and bundles under this Astro/Cloudflare Worker project.
Argon2id produces and verifies deterministic known vectors.
Independent cryptographic salt is generated securely.
Memory and iteration parameters execute within acceptable Worker limits.
Hash output uses a self-describing versioned representation.
No plaintext password is logged or persisted.
Production bundle does not import unsupported runtime APIs.

implementationCandidates.capability: Cloudflare Workers can execute imported precompiled WebAssembly modules.
risks: Worker WebAssembly loading/bundling requirements must be proven.
Third-party package provenance and maintenance quality must be reviewed.
Worker CPU and memory behavior must be measured.
Dynamic WebAssembly compilation patterns are not acceptable.

PasswordHasher.hash: Accept plaintext password only transiently and return a versioned encoded password hash.
PasswordHasher.verify: Accept plaintext password plus encoded stored hash and return verification result.
PasswordHasher.rehash: Expose whether an accepted stored hash should be upgraded when algorithm parameters change.
PasswordHasher.security: Never expose plaintext passwords or password hashes through principal-domain APIs.

normalization.email: Credential lookup uses one canonical email normalization function.
normalization.identity: Email remains mutable credential metadata and MUST NOT become PrincipalId.

repositoryResponsibility: Update a credential while preserving PrincipalId identity.
Never return credential records from PrincipalRepository.
persistenceBoundary.atomicityRule: Principal creation plus first credential creation must eventually define an explicit transaction/compensation boundary before public registration exists.

authenticationBoundary.credentialAuthentication: Email/password authentication resolves a verified credential to PrincipalId.
authenticationBoundary.principalStatus: A disabled principal must not receive an authenticated product session.
authenticationBoundary.enumerationResistance: Public authentication behavior must not disclose whether a normalized email exists.
authenticationBoundary.currentOperatorAuth: Existing River OS shared-key authentication remains independent and unchanged during this slice.

sessionBoundary.nextAfterCredentialAuth: Authenticated session architecture carrying or resolving PrincipalId
sessionBoundary.restriction: Do not retrofit the river-os-authenticated boolean into canonical product-user identity.

seshAuthorizationBoundary.rule: No creator-owned Sesh operation becomes public merely because password authentication exists.
seshAuthorizationBoundary.ownershipRequirement: Sesh project ownership/collaborator authorization remains mandatory after authentication.

capabilitySpike.title: Argon2id Worker Runtime Capability Spike
scope: Evaluate the primary Argon2id library candidate without creating user credentials.
Install candidate dependency only in a controlled source change.
Measure representative local execution time and memory settings.
Inspect generated Worker bundle for unsupported APIs.
successCriteria: Argon2id functions correctly under the project runtime/toolchain.
No unsupported Node Argon2 API is used.
No plaintext password persistence or logging exists.
Chosen parameter envelope is explicit and versioned.
Repository changes are limited to the approved capability spike.
capabilitySpike.failureBehavior: If the primary candidate cannot operate safely within Cloudflare Worker constraints, stop. Evaluate the secondary Argon2id candidate or create a separate explicit fallback-algorithm specification. Do not silently downgrade.

nonGoals: Persisting a password hash to production

authorization.dependencySpike: Local source work only; no live authorization required.
authorization.productionDatabaseMutation: Requires separate explicit authorization if later requested.
authorization.productionDeployment: Requires separate fresh explicit authorization immediately before deployment.

acceptanceCriteria: Argon2id remains the preferred password hashing algorithm.
Unsupported native node:crypto Argon2 is explicitly forbidden.
A primary Worker-compatible Argon2id capability candidate is identified.
No production library is declared proven until SESH-017 passes.
Credential persistence remains separate from PrincipalRepository.
River OS shared-key authentication remains distinct from PrincipalId.
PrincipalId to SeshCreatorId authorization remains deferred.
No live system is mutated by SESH-016.
